summary: End-to-end testing of the college dorm contract generator app. Backend: created pytest suite (13 tests) covering GET /api/fields, /api/upload (xlsx auto-map of all 16 Russian fields + 400 on non-xlsx), POST /api/contracts + batch, GET list + case-insensitive search by ФИО/номер, GET /api/contracts/{id}/download for docx (validates no leftover {{}} Jinja placeholders and Cyrillic content) and pdf (LibreOffice), POST /api/contracts/preview, POST /api/contracts/batch-download (docx and pdf ZIPs), and DELETE. All 13/13 passed. Frontend (Playwright against public URL): uploaded xlsx via hidden input, verified student table + column mapping (full_name→ФИО), search filter, select-all, batch generate + ZIP download (72KB), Edit dialog opens with prefilled fields, editing full_name propagated into downloaded .docx (filename showed edited name, 38KB), History page listed saved contracts, search filtered results, docx download from history worked, delete confirm dialog removed the row.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y warning, not blocking). Add DialogDescription.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to EditContractDialog and AlertDialog to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend LGTM: uses UUID ids (no _id leak), proper /api prefix, LibreOffice PDF conversion has 90s timeout and error handling, batch-download handles duplicate filenames.
auto_map_columns keyword ordering places 'адрес' after 'адрес регистрации' which correctly matches long-keyword-first via greedy score sort - verified all 16 map with given Russian headers.
Minor: /api/contracts/preview accepts format as query param but /api/contracts uses body — inconsistency is intentional (matches frontend usage) but worth noting.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly, all interactive elements have data-testid, files are all <400 lines.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created xlsx /tmp/ui_students.xlsx and TEST_/UI_ prefixed contracts. All cleaned up post-run (backend tests delete their own, UI_ ones cleaned via curl).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_contracts_api.py runs green in ~6s (pytest-xdist enabled). Public URL: https://numbers-586.preview.emergentagent.com. For UI file upload, use page.set_input_files on '[data-testid="excel-file-input"]' (input is hidden - don't wait for visibility). PDF flow can take a few seconds due to LibreOffice.
